My family has been shopping at pet resources for years, they sent me one day before I had any idea what I would find and now half of my reptile baby I have I purchased here. The service is always wonderful. The manager to me feels like a dear friend he is never too far always willing to help me with anything I’m looking for. I call him boss man lol. 😃 The staff are very polite and friendly looking to help you in anyway possible.  Sometimes I go in not knowing what to get for my reptiles and they are patient with me and always try the very best to help me find what I’m looking for. The pricing for everything is always right up my alley I never feel like they are over charging me for anything. The store maintenance is always kept up to par I never have any complaints any time I visit to make my purchases or just to even ask a question about something I bought they are always respectful and helpful. I don’t ever see myself going to no other pet store. If you shop here I promise you won’t be displeased ever !! I promise !! Here’s a picture of today’s order I got superworms, crickets , mealworms, fuzzy and wean rat to feed my babies at home. Very well loved and respected store in my neighborhood.

I bought three beautiful large fish with a long tail on May 9 unfortunately they were too big for my tank and fish in my aquarium so I went back May 10 to try to do an exchange because it was unfair to the fish to not have the space they need. The girl in the front asked if I was gonna do an exchange I said yes a gentleman that was working there said if I was donating them, he would take them. I said no I was trying to do an exchange because the fish were too big for my tank for something smaller and they said they don’t do any exchanges. Sad But I’m not gonna donate something I paid for the fish were an excellent condition and I just wanted to exchange for something smaller. I try to go to small businesses to give the support, but that’s why I have to stay loyal to Petco and PetSmart. Thank you pet resources.

I had to change my review because last yr everything was stocked with fish and aquatic plants now the quality of it all had downgraded with a bunch of dead fish and plants in the tanks..I appreciate having a local pet shop because I don't have to travel far but when I spend almost $70 on 3 guppies, 1 small pleco, 3 snails, 1 cory, and 1  $9 Bottle of parasite gaurd for my quarantine tank and 2 days later all of my fish died is very disappointing 😢.. I breed guppies at home and have over 10 different  generations but sometimes I like to support the local community petshop and look at guppies to determine whether i want to buy more depending on type and color variations. With this being said I will just buy fish food and keep breeding my own fish.
